timer_plan.PT_durations: Not applicable: durations are logical invocation counts, not wall-clock time.
timer_plan.reset_conditions: No timer FBs exist. The elapsed tick counter resets on disable and on every phase transition.

priorities: Disable has highest priority: immediately reset phase and elapsed_ticks to zero, regardless of Tick.
Otherwise, count one tick on every scan with Tick TRUE, including consecutive TRUE scans; do not use a rising-edge detector.
When enabled and Tick is FALSE, retain phase and elapsed_ticks.
Each scan performs at most one phase transition and publishes the resulting phase in the same scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample Enable and Tick once into scan-local values. Tick is used as a level, not edge-detected.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Apply disable reset first; otherwise execute the applicable state transition using retained pre-scan phase and elapsed_ticks. Scan 0 executes normally.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No calls: this design requires no timer FBs.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign Phase := phase; Red := (phase = 0); Green := (phase = 1); Amber := (phase = 2), using post-transition state.

formal_assertions.formula: G(X (Enable & !Tick) -> ((Red -> X Red) & (Green -> X Green) & (Amber -> X Amber)))
